subject: Install direct Codrops 8:5 Candidate 01 in Design resident
body: Install Candidate 01 branch SHA fd66065a05c75243222ccfaee7e4885e210e9b40 into the local Doré Design resident. This version deliberately removes all Candidate 01 editorial wrappers and motion overrides. Candidate 01 must embed dore-design/codrops_site_8x5.py directly, with no 4W runtime, living-current layer, mosaic layer, custom focus CSS, or extra hover logic. Do not alter public homepage.

argv: HTML=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01'); printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'GridToFullPreview 8:5' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'candidate-01-editorial-contract-runtime' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'candidate-01-codrops-8x5-embed' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'dore-mosaic-layer' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'candidate-01-living-editorial-runtime'
